```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(caret)
library(mlbench)
library(tidyverse)

set.seed(100)

# https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dRqtLxZVRuw
```

# build class labels

```{r class labels}
inc_data <- read.csv("inc_dbl_scr.csv")

inc_classifier <- inc_data %>%
  mutate(session_type = case_when(
    drug == 1 & session == 1 ~ "h_d1",
    drug == 1 & session == 2 ~ "h_d30",
    drug == 2 & session == 1 ~ "s_d1",
    drug == 2 & session == 2 ~ "s_d30"  
  )) %>%
  group_by(subject, session_type) %>%
  summarise(
    beam = sum(beam, na.rm = TRUE),
    groom = sum(groom, na.rm = TRUE),
    sniff = sum(sniff, na.rm = TRUE),
    shake = sum(shake, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# clean up dataframe
inc_classifier<-ungroup(inc_classifier)
inc_classifier$session_type<-as.factor(inc_classifier$session_type)

sum(is.na(inc_classifier))
inc_classifier <- as.data.frame(inc_classifier)
summary(inc_classifier)
```

# split data

```{r split data}
# get unique subjects
unique_subjects <- unique(inc_classifier$subject)

# randomly sample 80% of subjects for training
train_subjects <- sample(unique_subjects, size = floor(0.8 * length(unique_subjects)))

# use remaining subjects for testing
test_subjects <- setdiff(unique_subjects, train_subjects)

# subset full dataset by subjects
trainingSet <- inc_classifier[inc_classifier$subject %in% train_subjects, ]
testingSet  <- inc_classifier[inc_classifier$subject %in% test_subjects, ]

# remove subject as it messes things up later
trainingSet <- trainingSet %>%
  select(-subject)

testingSet <- testingSet %>%
  select(-subject)

summary(trainingSet)
summary(testingSet)
```

# initialize training model and cross validation model

```{r training}
# build training model

# training model uses training set to build model
model <- train(session_type ~ ., 
               data = trainingSet,
               method = "svmPoly",
               na.action = na.omit,
               preProcess=c("scale","center"), # scale and center data
               trControl = trainControl(method="none"))

# build cross validation model
# ten-fold cross validation
# use 80% training data, ten-fold so it will group data into 10 groups
# it will hold out 1 group, incrementally, to train and then predict the held out group
# each group is held out once then averaged over the prediction performance 
model_cv <- train(session_type ~ ., data = trainingSet,
               method = "svmPoly",
               na.action = na.omit,
               preProcess=c("scale","center"),
               trControl = trainControl(method="cv", number=10),
               tuneGrid = data.frame(degree = 1, scale = 1, C = 1))
```

# apply model for prediciton

```{r prediction}
model_pred_training <- predict(model, trainingSet) # apply model to make prediction on training set
model_pred_testing <- predict(model, testingSet) # apply model to testing set
model_pred_cv <- predict(model_cv, trainingSet) # preform cross validation
```

# test model preformance (display confusion and stats)

```{r confusion}
model_confusion_training <- confusionMatrix(model_pred_training, trainingSet$session_type) 
model_confusion_testing <- confusionMatrix(model_pred_testing, testingSet$session_type) 
model_confusion_cv <- confusionMatrix(model_pred_cv, trainingSet$session_type) 

print(model_confusion_training)
print(model_confusion_testing)
print(model_confusion_cv)
```

# feature importance

```{r feature importance}
importance <- varImp(model_pred_testing)
plot(importance)
plot(importance, col = "red")
```
